description: A specialised hammer used to shape the back of a textblock by rounding it and fanning the sections outward to form the joint groove. A face of moderate size lets a glancing blow move the sections without flattening raised bands.
name: hammer

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter VIII, p.116. Internet Archive.
